form_analysis.feedback: Excellent aftercare form for multi-colour tattoo removal addressing the complexity of different ink responses. Strong guidance on wavelength-specific aftercare and staggered treatment approaches. Comprehensive coverage of paradoxical darkening risks and extended treatment timelines.

form_data.introduction: This aftercare is for removal of tattoos containing multiple ink colors requiring different laser wavelengths. Each color responds differently, and some colors (red/orange/yellow) have specific risks requiring special care between sessions.

instructions.general_directive: Follow specific care for each color treated. Multi-color removal requires extended timeline and may involve different lasers/wavelengths.

sections.title: Multi-Color Challenges
sections.content: Different inks absorb different wavelengths: Black (1064nm), Red/Orange (532nm), Green/Blue (755nm). Some colors fade faster than others, creating uneven appearance during treatment series.

sections.title: Wavelength-Specific Aftercare
items: 532nm (Red/Orange): HIGH risk of paradoxical darkening. Strict sun avoidance for 6+ weeks.
755nm (Green/Blue): May cause more textural changes. Gentle scar care.
694nm (Dark Blue/Black): Less common, similar to 1064nm care.

sections.title: Paradoxical Darkening Prevention (CRITICAL)
sections.content: Red, orange, flesh-toned, white, yellow inks may oxidize and turn BLACK with Q-switched laser. PREVENTION: 1) Test patch first 2) Use PICO-second if available 3) Strict sun avoidance 4) Consider different wavelengths. If darkening occurs, it may be permanent or require additional treatments.

sections.title: Staggered Treatment Approach
sections.content: For complex multi-color tattoos, different colors may be treated in separate sessions: Session 1: Black ink, Session 2: Red ink (8 weeks later), Session 3: Green ink (8 weeks later). This allows monitoring of each color's response.

sections.title: Color Fading Timelines
items: Black: First to show fading (2-4 sessions).
Red/Orange: May darken initially, then fade (4-8 sessions).
Green: Slow to respond, may require most sessions (8-12+).
Complete removal of all colors may not be possible.

sections.title: Realistic Multi-Color Expectations
items: Extended treatment series: 10-20+ sessions over 2-4 years.
Possible need for cover-up if complete removal not achieved.
Higher cost and time commitment than single-color removal.
